items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Henry Zeno was playing the drum with, with Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: Good readers. So you heard Dodds Plenty down here?
Oh, yeah. And Henry, Henry Zeno was playing the drum with, with Joe Oliver. Mm-hmm. Henry Zeno, he had a good little drummer too. Oh, fast. All him from his day. Mm-hmm.
What about George Washington, the drum with the player?
